Elemental Protection 2.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Elemental Protection 2.effect: The character protects themselves with their element. Any attacks against them that do 20 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 20 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.

Elemental Protection 3.name: Elemental Protection 3
Elemental Protection 3.description: The character's elemental protection is like a tank.
Elemental Protection 3.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Elemental Protection 3.effect: The character protects themselves with their element. Any attacks against them that do 30 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 30 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.

Elemental Protection 4.name: Elemental Protection 4
Elemental Protection 4.description: The character's elemental protection is like a fortress.
Elemental Protection 4.trigger: The character is attacked or otherwise in danger.
Elemental Protection 4.effect: The character protects themselves with their element. Any attacks against them that do 40 points of damage or less are instantly absorbed, and the protection continues. If an attack does more than 40 points of damage, it destroys the protection. Either way, the character remains unharmed.

Elemental Push.name: Elemental Push
Elemental Push.description: The character can move a target with their element.
Elemental Push.effect: The character makes an Ego attack against the target's Agility defense. If the attack succeeds, the character can move the target in any direction, up to 1 space times the character's rank. On a Fantastic success, the target also takes regular damage, is knocked prone and suffers the element's special effect.
Elemental Push.short_effect: Ego vs Agility; move 1 space/rank (+ damage, prone, special effect on Fantastic)

Elemental Reinforcement.name: Elemental Reinforcement
Elemental Reinforcement.description: The character reinforces their powers with their element.
Elemental Reinforcement.trigger: Damage gets through an elemental power
Elemental Reinforcement.effect: The character can transfer any Health damage that gets through an elemental power that grants damage protection to their Focus instead, leaving the protection intact.
Elemental Reinforcement.short_effect: Transfer Health damage from elemental protection to Focus

Elemental Ricochet.name: Elemental Ricochet
Elemental Ricochet.description: The character bounces the burst off one foe and into another.
Elemental Ricochet.effect: The character makes a ranged attack against a target in line of sight. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular damage. On a Fantastic success, energy also bounces off the first target to another in line of sight, and the character can make a new attack against that target, adding the new range to the previous attack's range. This can be repeated until an attack is not fantastic.
Elemental Ricochet.short_effect: Ranged attack; chain to next target on Fantastic (keep chaining on Fantastic)

Elemental Sphere.name: Elemental Sphere
Elemental Sphere.description: The character can create a protective sphere of their element.
Elemental Sphere.effect: The character envelops themselves-and any chosen people within up to 5 spaces times their rank-in a protective sphere comprised of their element. When the sphere is formed, the character makes an Ego check and compares the results against the Agility defense of unwanted characters in the enclosed spaces. On a success, such moved people suffer full damage and the element's special effect. Attacks against the sphere are against the character's Ego defense. Any attacks against the sphere are absorbed as if made against the character's Elemental Protection power, and the sphere continues. If an attack does more damage than the character's Elemental Protection power can sustain, it destroys the sphere, but no one inside is harmed.
Elemental Sphere.short_effect: Protective sphere (5 spaces/rank); absorbs damage per Elemental Protection level

Elemental Suffocation.name: Elemental Suffocation
Elemental Suffocation.description: The character envelops a target's head in an element.
Elemental Suffocation.trigger: The target is grabbed with Elemental Grab.
Elemental Suffocation.effect: The character makes an Ego attack against the grabbed target's Resilience defense. If the attack is a success, the target takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the target can also be pinned and suffers the element's special effect. With elements that aren't suited to suffocation, this power chokes the target instead.
Elemental Suffocation.short_effect: Ego vs Resilience on grabbed target; damage (pin + special effect on Fantastic)

Energy Absorption.name: Energy Absorption
Energy Absorption.description: The character turns damage into power.
Energy Absorption.effect: The character can take any Health damage done to them (after applying any damage reduction), ignore it and add that number to their Focus instead. In this way, they can increase their Focus up to double their regular maximum Focus. Once the combat is over, any extra Focus over the character's regular maximum Focus score fades away.
Energy Absorption.short_effect: Convert Health damage to Focus (up to 2× max); excess fades after combat

Environmental Protection.name: Environmental Protection
Environmental Protection.description: Environmental effects don't bother the character.
Environmental Protection.effect: The character is not harmed by intense cold or heat, the pressure of the deep seas or the intense radiation and vacuum of space. The player can choose any or all of these protections, as best fits with the character concept.
Environmental Protection.short_effect: Immune to extreme cold, heat, pressure, radiation, vacuum (choose as appropriate)

ESP.name: ESP
ESP.description: The character can sense the presence of others.
ESP.effect: The character can reach out with their mind to sense the presence of others within 100 spaces per rank. This tells them the person's location and general status. It can also identify if they have super-powers or not. If a target or targets wish to remain undetected, the character must make a Logic check and compare it against each target's Vigilance defense. If they succeed, they sense the target. On a Fantastic success, they can also identify the source of any powers the target has.
ESP.short_effect: Sense presence within 100 spaces/rank; Logic vs Vigilance if hiding

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description: The character can dodge fists quickly.
Evasion.effect: The character can use their Agility defense score against Melee attacks too.
Evasion.short_effect: Use Agility defense vs Melee attacks

Exorcism.name: Exorcism
Exorcism.description: The character removes an intruder from someone's body.
Exorcism.effect: The character attempts to remove the possessor from a possessed target. The character makes an Ego check against the possessor's Ego defense. On a success, the possessor's concentration is broken, ending the possession. On a Fantastic success, all of the possessor's concentrations are broken, and the possessor is stunned for one round too.
Exorcism.short_effect: Ego vs Ego; end possession (break all concentrations + stun on Fantastic)

Exploit.name: Exploit
Exploit.description: The character finds a weak spot and exploits it.
Exploit.trigger: A Fantastic success on an attack using the character's weapon that deals at least 1 point of damage
Exploit.effect: The character makes a Melee attack against the target's Resilience defense score. If the attack is a success, the damage it does ignores Health Damage Reduction. On a Fantastic success, the target suffers double damage and the weapon's special effect.
Exploit.short_effect: After weapon Fantastic: Melee vs Resilience, ignore Health Damage Reduction (double + special on Fantastic)

Extend Invisibility.name: Extend Invisibility
Extend Invisibility.description: The character makes something else invisible.
Extend Invisibility.effect: The character makes something-a single person or object-within reach invisible. This can be one size bigger than them for every rank they have.
Extend Invisibility.short_effect: Make one person/object within reach invisible (1 size/rank bigger)

Extended Reach 2.name: Extended Reach 2
Extended Reach 2.description: The character can reach a looong way.
Extended Reach 2.effect: The character's reach is 10 times normal.

Fast Attacks.name: Fast Attacks
Fast Attacks.effect: The character splits their attack to make two close attacks against separate targets within reach (or they can focus a single attack on a single target). Make a single Melee check and compare it to the targets' Melee defenses. On a success, the affected target takes half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the affected target takes full damage, and the character can make a bonus attack with this power against any target within reach, with the same effect.
Fast Attacks.short_effect: Two attacks at half damage; on Fantastic, full damage + bonus attack

Fast Hands.name: Fast Hands
Fast Hands.description: The character can shoot faster than the eye can blink.
Fast Hands.effect: The character gains one additional reaction per round. This reaction can be used only to trigger a Ranged Weapons power.
Fast Hands.short_effect: +1 reaction per round (Ranged Weapons powers only)

Fast Strikes.name: Fast Strikes
Fast Strikes.description: The character unleashes a flurry of strikes.
Fast Strikes.effect: The character splits their attack to make two close attacks against separate targets within reach (or they can focus a single attack on a single target). Make a single Melee check and compare it to the targets' Melee defenses. On a success, the affected target takes half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the affected target takes full damage.
Fast Strikes.short_effect: Two attacks at half damage (full on Fantastic)

Flames of the Faltine.name: Flames of the Faltine
Flames of the Faltine.description: The character shoots jets of enchanted fire from their hands.
Flames of the Faltine.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the Agility defense of a target in their line of sight. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the target takes double damage and then suffers 5 points of damage at the end of every round until someone uses an action to put out the flames.
Flames of the Faltine.short_effect: Ego vs Agility; double damage on Fantastic + 5 damage/round until extinguished

Flare.name: Flare
Flare.description: The character generates a dazzling flare of light.
Flare.effect: The character makes an Ego check and compares that against the Vigilance defense of every enemy within 5 spaces. Each beaten enemy is blinded for one turn. On a Fantastic success, the flare inflicts regular damage too.
Flare.short_effect: Ego vs Vigilance for all within 5 spaces; blind 1 turn (+ damage on Fantastic)

Flexible Bones 1.name: Flexible Bones 1
Flexible Bones 1.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 1. They also have an edge on Agility checks for contortion and escape.
Flexible Bones 1.short_effect: Health Damage Reduction 1; edge on contortion/escape

Flexible Bones 2.name: Flexible Bones 2
Flexible Bones 2.description: The character's skeleton is flexible and pliable.
Flexible Bones 2.effect: The character gains Health Damage Reduction 2. They also have a double edge on Agility checks for contortion and escape.
Flexible Bones 2.short_effect: Health Damage Reduction 2; double edge on contortion/escape

Flexible Fingers.name: Flexible Fingers
Flexible Fingers.description: The character can turn their fingers and hands into whatever tool they need.
Flexible Fingers.effect: With a standard action, the character can automatically pick any lock that requires a physical key. They can also shape their hands to form almost any other kind of simple tool.
Flexible Fingers.short_effect: Auto-pick physical locks; shape hands into simple tools

Flight 1.name: Flight 1
Flight 1.description: The character can soar into the sky.
Flight 1.effect: The character can fly. Their combat Flight Speed is equal to their rank times their Run Speed. Outside of combat, they can move three times their Flight Speed.
Flight 1.short_effect: Fly at rank × Run Speed (3× outside combat)

Flight 2.name: Flight 2
Flight 2.description: The character can zoom across the sky.
Flight 2.effect: Outside of combat, the character can fly up to 50 times their Flight Speed.

Flying Double Kick.name: Flying Double Kick
Flying Double Kick.description: The character leaps into the air and snap kicks two enemies at once.
Flying Double Kick.effect: The character makes a close attack against two enemies within reach. If an attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. If an attack is a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and is knocked prone.
Flying Double Kick.short_effect: Attack two enemies; double damage + prone on Fantastic

Focus Fire.name: Focus Fire
Focus Fire.description: The character calls out a target.
Focus Fire.effect: The character calls out an enemy in line of sight and inspires one or more allies of their choice in earshot, up to the character's Vigilance. They gain an edge on all action checks against that enemy.
Focus Fire.short_effect: Allies (up to Vigilance) gain edge vs one enemy

Focused Fury.name: Focused Fury
Focused Fury.description: The character channels their rage into a devastating blow.
Focused Fury.effect: The character makes a close attack with an edge. For this attack, add +1 to the character's Melee damage bonus for every 2 points of Focus they spend. On a success, an affected target takes that total damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes double that total damage and suffers the weapon's special effect.
Focused Fury.short_effect: Close attack with edge; +1 Melee damage per 2 Focus; double + special on Fantastic

Focused Strike.name: Focused Strike
Focused Strike.description: The character finds the right spot and strikes.
Focused Strike.effect: The character makes a close attack. Add +1 to the character's Melee damage bonus for every 2 points of Focus they spend. On a success, an affected target takes that total damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes double that total damage and is stunned for one round.
Focused Strike.short_effect: Close attack; +1 Melee damage per 2 Focus; double + stun on Fantastic

Fool.name: Fool
Fool.description: The character makes people believe they are someone else.
Fool.effect: The character uses a mirage to alter their appearance in the minds of anyone within 20 spaces per rank. Cameras (for instance) can still record them normally, but when people look in the character's direction, they see someone else. The target number for anyone trying to see through the mirage is the character's Logic defense. If the character is impersonating someone known to the other person, that person has an edge.
Fool.short_effect: Mental disguise within 20 spaces/rank; detection TN = Logic defense (edge if known person)

Furious Attacks.name: Furious Attacks
Furious Attacks.description: The character's weapons smash into the foe.
Furious Attacks.effect: The character splits their attack to make two close attacks against separate targets within reach (or they can focus a single attack on a single target). Make a single Melee check and compare it to the targets' Melee defenses. For these attacks, add +1 to the character's Melee damage bonus for every 2 points of Focus they spend. On a success, an affected target takes half that total damage. On a Fantastic success, an affected target takes full damage and suffers the weapon's special effect.
Furious Attacks.short_effect: Two attacks; +1 Melee damage per 2 Focus; half damage (full + special on Fantastic)

Grand Fool.name: Grand Fool
Grand Fool.description: The character mentally makes the group they're with appear to be like other people.
Grand Fool.effect: The character uses a mirage to alter their appearance-and the appearance of up to one other person per rank, within 10 spaces-in the minds of people within 20 spaces per rank. Cameras (for instance) can still record them, but when people look in the characters' direction, they see other people. The target number for anyone trying to see through the mirage is the character's Logic defense. If the affected characters are impersonating people known to the other person, that person has an edge.
Grand Fool.short_effect: Mental disguise for self + 1/rank within 10 spaces; detection TN = Logic defense

Grand Illusion.name: Grand Illusion
Grand Illusion.description: By manipulating light and sound, the character creates an incredibly real hologram.
Grand Illusion.effect: The character creates a sound and sight illusion anywhere in line of sight, within 50 spaces. The illusion can be of anything up to five sizes larger than the character, and it can move freely within its limits. The character breaks concentration if they move beyond 50 spaces from the illusion or lose line of sight of it.
Grand Illusion.short_effect: Moving audio-visual illusion (up to 5 sizes larger) within 50 spaces

Grand Mirage.name: Grand Mirage
Grand Mirage.description: The character can make a mirage appear in a group's mind.
Grand Mirage.effect: The character creates a full-sensory mirage that affects everyone in a Telepathic Network they set up who is also in the same locale. The mirage can be of anything the character desires, and it can move freely.
Grand Mirage.short_effect: Full-sensory mirage for entire Telepathic Network in same location

Grappling Technique.name: Grappling Technique
Grappling Technique.effect: The character makes a close attack. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage and is grabbed. On a Fantastic success, the target takes double damage instead and is pinned too.
Grappling Technique.short_effect: Close attack; damage + grab (double + pin on Fantastic)

Ground-Shaking Stomp.name: Ground-Shaking Stomp
Ground-Shaking Stomp.description: The character smashes the ground so hard the earth trembles.
Ground-Shaking Stomp.effect: The character makes a Melee check and compares that against the Agility defense of every target within the character's reach plus their rank in spaces. Any targets the attack succeeds against take half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the targets take full damage and are knocked prone.
Ground-Shaking Stomp.short_effect: Melee vs Agility for all within reach + rank spaces; half damage (full + prone on Fantastic)

Group Flight.name: Group Flight
Group Flight.description: The character can carry others with them into the sky.
Group Flight.effect: For every point of Ego the character has, they can hoist one ally into the air with them. The Flight Speed of the group is half the character's, and all affected allies must remain within 5 spaces times the character's rank. The character controls each ally's speed and position during the character's turn, but they can release any or all allies at any time.
Group Flight.short_effect: Fly with allies (1 per Ego point) at half speed; within 5 spaces/rank

Group Invisibility.name: Group Invisibility
Group Invisibility.description: The character can make something else invisible.
Group Invisibility.effect: For every point of Ego defense the character has, they can make one person or thing invisible, including themselves. Each of these can be one size bigger than them for every rank they have.
Group Invisibility.short_effect: Make 1 per Ego defense invisible (1 size/rank bigger each)

Group Levitation.name: Group Levitation
Group Levitation.description: The character can lift others into the air too.
Group Levitation.effect: The character can move up to one person per rank through the air in any direction at the character's Run Speed. The levitated target(s) must remain within 5 spaces times the character's rank. If any target does not wish to be moved like this, they must be telekinetically grabbed first.
Group Levitation.short_effect: Levitate 1 per rank at Run Speed; within 5 spaces/rank (grab if unwilling)

Grow 1.name: Grow 1
Grow 1.effect: The character can grow up to huge size. They can return to their normal size at will.
Grow 1.short_effect: Grow to huge size (reversible at will)

Grow 2.name: Grow 2
Grow 2.effect: The character can grow up to gigantic size. They can return to their normal size at will.
Grow 2.short_effect: Grow to gigantic size (reversible at will)

Grow 3.name: Grow 3
Grow 3.description: The character can be the size of a house!
Grow 3.effect: The character can grow up to titanic size. They can return to their normal size at will.
Grow 3.short_effect: Grow to titanic size (reversible at will)

Grow 4.name: Grow 4
Grow 4.effect: The character can grow up to gargantuan size. They can return to their normal size at will.
Grow 4.short_effect: Grow to gargantuan size (reversible at will)

Growing Attack.name: Growing Attack
Growing Attack.description: The character attacks as they grow
Growing Attack.effect: The character makes a close attack with an edge. If the attack succeeds, they do regular damage for the size they are growing to. On a Fantastic success, they do double damage and stun the target.
Growing Attack.short_effect: Close attack with edge when growing; damage for new size (double + stun on Fantastic)

Headshot.name: Headshot
Headshot.effect: The character makes a ranged attack with trouble on an enemy within the weapon's range. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes double normal damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes triple damage. Either way, if the enemy suffers any actual damage, they are also stunned for one round.
Headshot.short_effect: Ranged attack with trouble; double damage + stun (triple on Fantastic)

Healing Factor.name: Healing Factor
Healing Factor.effect: At the end of the character's turn, they regain Health equal to their Resilience. (This works outside of combat too, quickly bringing them back to full Health.)
Healing Factor.short_effect: Regain Health equal to Resilience each turn

Heightened Senses 1.name: Heightened Senses 1
Heightened Senses 1.effect: The character can sense things roughly twice as far away as normal. They also have an edge on Vigilance checks to perceive things, and enemies have trouble on checks they make to sneak past the character.
Heightened Senses 1.short_effect: Sense range ×2; edge on Vigilance to perceive; enemies have trouble sneaking

Heightened Senses 2.name: Heightened Senses 2
Heightened Senses 2.description: The character has senses as sharp as radar.
Heightened Senses 2.effect: The character can sense things roughly four times as far away as normal. Their senses are so sharp that they can use some of them to compensate for the loss of others (say, if blinded or deafened). They can even listen to the heartbeat of a person in the same room to see if they are lying-although this is as reliable as a traditional lie detector: far from 100% and not admissible in court. They also have a double edge on Vigilance checks to perceive things, and enemies have double trouble on checks they make to sneak past the character.
Heightened Senses 2.short_effect: Sense range ×4; compensate for lost senses; detect lies; double edge on Vigilance; enemies have double trouble sneaking

Hellfire Chains.name: Hellfire Chains
Hellfire Chains.description: The character shoots out chains covered in hellfire.
Hellfire Chains.effect: The character summons chains covered in hellfire and can use them to bind or smash targets. They can attack anyone within 10 spaces per rank and line of sight. Make an Ego attack. On a success, the target takes regular Health damage. On a Fantastic success, the target is grabbed and paralyzed too. If a target is grabbed by the hellfire chains, on each subsequent round, the character can make an Ego check against the target's Resilience Resilience defense to inflict regular Health damage and regular Focus damage. Breaking free from the hellfire chains requires a Melee check with a target number of 20.
Hellfire Chains.short_effect: Ego attack at 10 spaces/rank; damage (grab + paralyze on Fantastic); subsequent rounds deal Health + Focus damage; escape TN 20

Hex Bolt.name: Hex Bolt
Hex Bolt.description: The character hurls a hex bolt at their foe.
Hex Bolt.effect: The character fires a hex bolt at a foe. Make an Ego check against the target's Agility defense. On a success, the attack does regular damage. On a Fantastic success, it does double damage and causes the target trouble for one round.
Hex Bolt.short_effect: Ego vs Agility; double damage + trouble for 1 round on Fantastic

Hit & Run.name: Hit & Run
Hit & Run.description: The character hits hard and keeps moving!
Hit & Run.effect: The character makes a close attack with an edge on an enemy. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage, and the character can make an additional movement up to half their Run Speed for free. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and suffers the weapon's special effect.
Hit & Run.short_effect: Close attack with edge; move half Run Speed for free (double + special on Fantastic)

Hit the Dirt.name: Hit the Dirt
Hit the Dirt.description: The character gets their allies to take cover.
Hit the Dirt.trigger: An enemy in line of sight makes an attack on an ally within earshot.
Hit the Dirt.effect: All allies within earshot can fall prone if they wish and are able to. If falling prone makes the ally an ineligible target for the initial attack, the attack automatically fails.
Hit the Dirt.short_effect: Allies can fall prone; if out of range/sight, attack fails

Hurled Shield Bash.name: Hurled Shield Bash
Hurled Shield Bash.description: The character hurls their mighty shield at an enemy.
Hurled Shield Bash.effect: The character makes a ranged attack on an enemy. If the attack is a success, the enemy takes regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double damage and is knocked prone. The shield then bounces back to the character.
Hurled Shield Bash.short_effect: Ranged attack; double damage + prone on Fantastic; shield returns

Hurled Shield Block.name: Hurled Shield Block
Hurled Shield Block.description: The character hurls their mighty shield to protect an ally from an attack.
Hurled Shield Block.trigger: An enemy makes an attack against an ally's Agility.
Hurled Shield Block.effect: The ally gains Health Damage Reduction equal to the character's Shield power against that attack. The shield then bounces back to the character.
Hurled Shield Block.short_effect: Ally gains Health Damage Reduction equal to Shield level; shield returns

Hurled Shield Deflection.name: Hurled Shield Deflection
Hurled Shield Deflection.description: The character hurls their mighty shield to save an ally from an attack.
Hurled Shield Deflection.trigger: An enemy makes an attack against an ally's Agility.
Hurled Shield Deflection.effect: The enemy has trouble on the attack. The shield then bounces back to the character.
Hurled Shield Deflection.short_effect: Enemy has trouble on attack; shield returns

Iconic Weapon.name: Iconic Weapon
Iconic Weapon.effect: The character is known for owning and using a unique and powerful weapon, like Mjolnir (Thor's hammer) or Captain America's shield. The Narrator must approve the details of this weapon. This power can be taken more than once, but each time must be with a different weapon.
Iconic Weapon.short_effect: Own iconic unique weapon (Narrator approval required)

Icy Tendrils of Ikthalon.name: Icy Tendrils of Ikthalon
Icy Tendrils of Ikthalon.description: The character unleashes freezing tendrils at a foe.
Icy Tendrils of Ikthalon.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the Agility defense of a target in their line of sight. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes double that total damage and is paralyzed by the ice.
Icy Tendrils of Ikthalon.short_effect: Ego vs Agility; double damage + paralyze on Fantastic

Illumination.name: Illumination
Illumination.description: The character creates a bright light.
Illumination.effect: The character illuminates one object or point in line of sight, within 50 spaces, with bright light. The character can maintain concentration on the effect even if they move out of range or line of sight.
Illumination.short_effect: Create bright light at point within 50 spaces; maintains if moving away

Images of Ikonn.name: Images of Ikonn
Images of Ikonn.description: The character creates illusory duplicates of a person.
Images of Ikonn.effect: The character creates one sound and sight illusory duplicate per rank of one person they've met (including themselves). The duplicates look and sound exactly like the original and are under the character's complete control. They start in the same space as the character and instantly move into any open space around them, up to 2 spaces away, during which time the character can swap places with any of the duplicates. If the character is duplicating themselves, the character's player should secretly record which one is the actual character. The duplicates can move up to 10 spaces away from the character, and they can pretend to attack (and miss) opponents. Any attack that hits a duplicate instantly removes it. If the character successfully attacks someone or does something else to make the truth evident, the illusion ends. This spell can also be used to see through someone else's illusion. When used in this way, it gives the character a double edge on their Ego check.
Images of Ikonn.short_effect: Create 1 duplicate/rank; can swap places; move 10 spaces; hit removes duplicate; double edge vs illusions

Immovable.name: Immovable
Immovable.trigger: The character is knocked back or knocked prone.
Immovable.effect: For every point of Melee defense the character has, they can reduce knockback by 1 space.
Immovable.short_effect: Reduce knockback by 1 space per Melee defense

Information Upload.name: Information Upload
Information Upload.description: The character can transmit loads of information straight into another's mind.
Information Upload.effect: The character transmits a knowledge-based label (a trait or tag) of their own to a target with whom they have established a telepathic link-willing or not. The label lasts until the target sleeps. The character can also impart any other kind of knowledge they have to a target this way. The process is almost instantaneous.
Information Upload.short_effect: Transfer trait/tag or knowledge to linked target; lasts until sleep

Inspiration.name: Inspiration
Inspiration.description: The character's words inspire their allies.
Inspiration.effect: The character inspires an ally in earshot. The ally gains an edge on all action checks until the start of the character's next turn.
Inspiration.short_effect: One ally gains edge on all checks for 1 round

Instant Replay.name: Instant Replay
Instant Replay.effect: Once per battle, the character can make a second attempt at a check that they just failed, erasing and replacing the first attempt entirely.
Instant Replay.short_effect: Once per battle: retry failed check

Integrity.name: Integrity
Integrity.description: The character can think their way through.
Integrity.effect: The character can use their Logic defense score against Ego attacks too.
Integrity.short_effect: Use Logic defense vs Ego attacks

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description: The character turns as transparent as glass.
Invisibility.effect: The character becomes invisible. They have an edge on Agility checks to sneak past people, and enemies have trouble on Vigilance checks to perceive them. It's even harder to spot things that are invisible but aren't moving. Characters must be actively trying to do so to be able to make a Vigilance check.
Invisibility.short_effect: Invisible; edge on sneaking; enemies have trouble perceiving

Jinx.name: Jinx
Jinx.description: The character puts a jinx on a foe.
Jinx.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the target's Ego defense. If it succeeds, the target has trouble on all actions. On a Fantastic success, the target loses their next standard action.
Jinx.short_effect: Ego vs Ego; trouble on all actions (lose next action on Fantastic)

Jump 1.name: Jump 1
Jump 1.description: The character can leap about like a frog.
Jump 1.effect: The character gains the Jump movement mode with a Jump Speed equal to their Run Speed. They can jump this distance in any direction, vertically as well as horizontally.
Jump 1.short_effect: The character gains the Jump movement mode with a Jump Speed equal to their Run Speed. They can jump this distance in any direction, vertically as wel...

Jump 2.name: Jump 2
Jump 2.description: The character can leap around with dazzling speed.
Jump 2.effect: The character's Jump Speed is equal to their rank times their Run Speed. Outside of combat, they can move three times as fast.
Jump 2.short_effect: The character's Jump Speed is equal to their rank times their Run Speed. Outside of combat, they can move three times as fast.

Jump 3.name: Jump 3
Jump 3.description: The character can leap into the sky with a single bound.
Jump 3.effect: Outside of combat, the character can jump up to 50 times their Jump Speed.
Jump 3.short_effect: Outside of combat, the character can jump up to 50 times their Jump Speed.

Keep Moving.name: Keep Moving
Keep Moving.description: The character can keep allies moving under fire.
Keep Moving.trigger: An ally in line of sight and earshot is demoralized or stunned.
Keep Moving.effect: The demoralized or stunned condition ends.
Keep Moving.short_effect: The demoralized or stunned condition ends.

Kill Zone.trigger: An enemy in the character's line of sight starts to move.

Either way, the character regains their reaction. Each target can be affected by this attack by this character only once per round.

Leaping Leglock.effect: The character makes a close attack against an enemy. If the attack is a success, the enemy is grabbed and dealt regular damage. Leg Sweep.description: The character knocks the enemy's legs from under them.
Leg Sweep.effect: The character makes a close attack. If it succeeds, the enemy takes regular damage and is knocked prone. If it's a Fantastic success, the enemy is stunned for one round too.

Levitation.name: Levitation
Levitation.description: The character can hover and move.
Levitation.effect: The character can move through the air in any direction at their Run Speed.
Levitation.short_effect: The character can move through the air in any direction at their Run Speed.

Lightning Actions.name: Lightning Actions
Lightning Actions.effect: The character has one extra standard action and one extra reaction each turn. Additionally, they can turn their Marvel die to a Fantastic success when making an initiative check.

Machine Telepathy.name: Machine Telepathy
Machine Telepathy.description: The character can communicate with machines with their mind.
Machine Telepathy.effect: The character can communicate telepathically with one machine at a time, and they must have met or seen the machine before. The communication can be verbal, visual or even more complex, such as imparting location information. There is no limit to the distance of the communication, as long as the character and the machine are in the same dimension. Simple machines do not have much to offer in the way of conversation, but they are also generally compliant with requests. Complex machines-like computers, smartphones and other electronics-are also often compliant, but if they are secured in any way, they usually refuse to communicate with strangers. A Logic check can get the character past such security, and the Narrator should set the target number according to the strength of the security.

Macrodimensional Travel.name: Macrodimensional Travel
Macrodimensional Travel.effect: The character can grow enough to travel into the Macroverse, the Overspace or other dimensions of enlarged space. They can return to their normal size at will. Note that this is something that most characters would rarely want to do, as it removes them entirely from their regular universe and places them in a dimension in which the rules of time and space work differently. An hour in the Macroverse, for example, is roughly equivalent to a month in a regular universe. A trip to the Overspace is too overwhelming for most minds to handle.

Memory Blip.name: Memory Blip
Memory Blip.description: The character erases a bit of someone's memory.
Memory Blip.effect: The character causes a target with whom they've established a Telepathic Link to forget something that's happened in the past hour. This gap can be up to an hour in length. The character makes a Logic check against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the memories are forgotten. On a Fantastic success, the target has trouble on checks to recover such memories in the future. Any time the target is given good reason to question the blank in their memory, they can make a Logic check to recover their memory. If they succeed, the original memory floods back. On a Fantastic success, they know for sure who did this to them.

Mental Punch.name: Mental Punch
Mental Punch.description: The character can blast a foe's mind in melee.
Mental Punch.effect: The character makes a Melee attack against a target. If the attack is a success, it inflicts regular Focus damage (instead of Health damage). On a Fantastic success, the target takes double damage instead and is stunned for one round.

Mental Shelter.description: The character can create a shelter for their mind.
Mental Shelter.effect: The character extends their mental defenses to protect any chosen people within up to 5 spaces times their rank. The protected targets are granted Focus Damage Reduction equal to the character's Uncanny power.

Microdimensional Travel.name: Microdimensional Travel
Microdimensional Travel.description: The character shrinks out of the universe!
Microdimensional Travel.effect: The character can shrink enough to travel into subatomic realms. They can return to their normal size at will. Note that this is something that most characters would rarely want to do, as it removes them entirely from their regular universe and places them in a dimension in which the rules of time and space work differently. The Underspace, for example, might make a fine place to hide, but there's little else of interest there.

Mighty 1.effect: Treat the character as one size bigger for lifting, carrying, swinging and throwing things. They also add +1 to their Melee damage multiplier, and they gain a +1 bonus to Melee checks other than attacks.

Mighty 2.description: The character could lift a bus.

Mighty 4.description: The character is among the strongest there are.

Mind Interrogation.name: Mind Interrogation
Mind Interrogation.description: The character can root through a target's mind.
Mind Interrogation.effect: The character can delve into the mind of a single person with whom they have established a telepathic link. This requires a Logic check against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the character can ask a single simple question and get the answer from the target's mind. On a Fantastic success, the character can get more complex information.

On a success, the character can read the target's surface thoughts. On a Fantastic success, the character can ask a single simple question and get the answer from the target's mind.

Mirage.effect: The character creates a full-sensory mirage that affects any target with whom they have established a link. The mirage can be of anything the character desires, and it can move freely.

Molecular Destabilization.name: Molecular Destabilization
Molecular Destabilization.description: The character causes something to vibrate fast enough to explode.
Molecular Destabilization.effect: The character makes a close attack against an object their size or smaller. If the attack is a success, the object explodes. All targets within 2 spaces of the object-other than the character-take regular damage. On a Fantastic success, double the damage and ignore any Health Damage Reduction.

Multiversal Portal.name: Multiversal Portal
Multiversal Portal.description: The character opens a portal to another universe.
Multiversal Portal.effect: The character opens a glowing portal in a space next to them that moves anything that enters it between that space and its destination, which forms a matched glowing portal in the other place. The other end of the portal must be in a clear space in another universe that the character has been to. Anything can move through the portal in either direction until it is closed, which the character can do at will.

Multiversal Travel.name: Multiversal Travel
Multiversal Travel.description: The character moves from one universe to another.
Multiversal Travel.effect: The character instantly moves from their current universe to another universe. For instance: from Earth-616 to Earth-65. When they move to the other universe, they can arrive in any place they've been to before. Otherwise, they arrive at the closest available corresponding space in the other universe.

Multiversal Travel Other.name: Multiversal Travel Other
Multiversal Travel Other.description: The character sends someone to another universe.
Multiversal Travel Other.effect: The character makes an Ego check against the Vigilance of a target they have grabbed. If the check is successful, the character can send the target to another universe. The target can be sent to any location in that universe that the character has been to before. Otherwise, the target arrives at the closest available corresponding space in the other universe.

Multiversal Travel Together.description: The character brings someone with them to another universe.
Multiversal Travel Together.effect: The character moves to a different universe, taking any person they are touching with them. If the target does not wish to come along, the character must grab them first. When they move to the other universe, they can arrive in any place they've been to before. Otherwise, they arrive at the closest available corresponding space in the other universe.

On Your Feet.description: The character stands their friends on their feet.
On Your Feet.trigger: An ally in line of sight and earshot is knocked prone.
On Your Feet.effect: All prone allies within earshot, who are able to, can immediately stand up for free. Allies currently unable to stand up for any reason are not affected.

Operations Center.name: Operations Center
Operations Center.description: The character directs their allies in combat.
Operations Center.effect: The character inspires one or more allies of their choice in earshot, up to the character's Vigilance defense. Affected allies gain an edge on all action checks until the start of the character's next turn. The character breaks concentration on this power if they use a movement action.

Orders.name: Orders
Orders.description: The character forces someone to follow a complex set of orders.
Orders.effect: The character gives an order to a target with whom they've established a Telepathic Link and who has no Focus left. The character makes a Logic check against the target's Logic defense. On a success, the target complies with the orders. On a Fantastic success, the character gains an edge the next time they use this power against this same target. The command must be to do something that can be completed in an hour or less. If it involves harming someone, the character has trouble on the check. If it would cause the target to harm themselves, the character has double trouble on the check.

Penance Stare.name: Penance Stare
Penance Stare.description: The character can punish the wicked with their gaze.
Penance Stare.effect: The character makes an Ego attack against a target character within 3 spaces per rank. If it's a success, the target takes Focus damage. On a Fantastic success, the target takes double damage and is paralyzed for one round. Characters with the Heroic tag take half the listed damage from this power in either case. If a target is shattered by this power, they can recover, but they come back in one of two ways. Either they are cleansed of their sins and ready to make a new start with a clean slate, or their emotions are drained from them permanently. How this works in each case is up to the Narrator.

Phase Object.description: The character can make something they're touching intangible.
Phase Object.effect: The character can make any object they are touching intangible. The object (and things attached to or inside of it) can be up to their rank in sizes bigger than them. For example, if they are Rank 5, the object can be 5 sizes bigger than them. For an average person, this would be Gargantuan.

Webtrapping.effect: The character fills up to 5 spaces with sticky webs, and the affected spaces are considered difficult terrain. Any creature that starts its turn in or moves into an affected space must make an Agility check (target number 20) or be paralyzed by the webbing. Breaking free from webbing requires a Melee check (target number 20).

Whirling Frenzy.description: The character assaults a foe with a tornado of whirling attacks.
Whirling Frenzy.effect: The character makes an Agility check and compares it against the Agility defense of every enemy within their reach. If an attack is a success, the enemy takes half regular damage. On a Fantastic success, the enemy takes full damage and suffers the weapon's special effect.

Winds of Watoomb.name: Winds of Watoomb
Winds of Watoomb.description: The character creates swirling winds for protection.
Winds of Watoomb.trigger: Damage gets through the Shield of the Seraphim
Winds of Watoomb.effect: The character conjures swirling winds that they control. All movement by a foe within 10 spaces per the character's rank is cut in half. The character can also use this spell to push away smoke, mist or fog. If such a thing was created by a power, the character makes an Ego check with an edge against the Ego defense of the opposing controller. On a success, the controller's power ends. On a Fantastic success, the controller is knocked prone. Additionally, the Winds of Watoomb can be used to reinforce the Shield of the Seraphim. The character can transfer any Health damage that gets through the Shield of the Seraphim's protection to their Focus instead, leaving the Shield of the Seraphim intact.

Wisecracker.description: The character irritates a foe with their sharp wit.
Wisecracker.trigger: The character succeeds in an attack on an enemy in earshot, or an enemy in earshot fails an attack on them.
Wisecracker.effect: The character cracks a joke at the enemy's expense. Make an Ego attack. On a success, it does regular Focus damage. On a Fantastic success, the damage is doubled, and the target is stunned for one round.
